figure_validation.nonexact_rebuild_scope: Final encoder-depth label stream placement only; data, axes, intervals, and dimensions match

source_transfer_policy: Fifty-nine source files were selected individually through an explicit source-to-destination allowlist. Python copies were adapted and token/AST-sanitized; current paper PDFs were metadata-stripped without raster changes.
comment_policy: Every Python file was parsed, all tokenize.COMMENT tokens and module/function/class docstrings were removed, and critical Ruff syntax/name checks passed.
known_scientific_scope: Current IntPhys2 paper-facing inference uses a post-hoc five-fold scene cross-fit with every scene held out exactly once and a global fixed-prediction scene bootstrap.
The controlled geometry result is reproduced from bundled development and sealed compact representations; the completed 10000-draw sealed computation was not rerun during packaging.

The multi-dose V-JEPA2-G analysis is post-sealed exploratory; processed outputs are bundled and the omitted packed cache is regenerable from public IntPhys2, the released checkpoint, and included scripts.
Pair-held-out and repeated scene-holdout IntPhys2 outputs are retained only as superseded audit trails.
IntPhys2 intervals condition on fitted out-of-fold predictions and omit probe-refitting and fold-assignment variability.
JEPA-WM is a post-hoc exploratory PushT extension over the same episode units and target bytes as DINO-WM and does not isolate an architectural cause.
Kubric uses eight exploratory scenes; the generated render tree is omitted and exact byte-identical rerendering is limited by the uncaptured KuBasic asset-manifest hash.
compute_resource_scope: environments/compute_resources.json records measured times for 21 paper-facing stages and identifies untimed deterministic CPU postprocessing.
external_asset_scope: Third-party datasets, checkpoints, and source trees are not redistributed and remain under their own licenses; public locations, revisions, and available hashes are recorded.
license_scope: The archive root license is absent; scripts/KUBRIC_LICENSE and scripts/KUBRIC_NOTICE are retained.
line_ending_policy: .gitattributes pins text payload checkout to LF and binary assets to binary treatment before SHA-256 verification.
